name: Default
shortDescription: Hasura GraphQL Engine with its web console and a bundled PostgreSQL database, exposing GraphQL and REST APIs over the tables you track.

alerts.message: The console and the APIs are protected by an admin secret: enter the generated HASURA_GRAPHQL_ADMIN_SECRET from the environment settings when the console asks for it. Then connect the bundled database under Data > Connect Database using the environment variable PG_DATABASE_URL.
